newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Tel to launch interactive TV in Oct.
newsitem.headline: HK Tel to launch interactive TV in Oct.

text.p: Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd said on Monday it will launch its interactive television services in October and expects to invest about HK$2 billion in the project over the coming two years.

The firm already has invested HK$400 million in developing the services, William Lo, managing director at Hongkong Telecom IMS Ltd, the listed company's interactive multimedia services unit, told Reuters.
The interactive television services -- video-on-demand, home shopping and home banking -- would command an investment of more than HK$10 billion over the next 10 years, he said.
The company wants to have 250,000 to 300,000 users within the first two years of operation and expects to break even within four years, Lo said.
The services would be available to about 15 percent of Hong Kong's 1.6 million households in October and about 80 percent by mid-1999, he said.
